name: Tomas Tobé - Après le § 48 - Am 41
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 48c. Stresses that fact-checking must, under no circumstances, serve as an automatic basis for the removal, demotion or demonetisation of lawful content, and that any such decision must always fall within the remit of an independent judicial authority rather than private bodies financed by the institutions whose activities they are supposed to assess;
